newsitem.title: UK: M & C Saatchi forms sponsorship advice company.
newsitem.headline: M & C Saatchi forms sponsorship advice company.

text.p: M & C Saatchi, the advertising agency founded by Maurice Saatchi, on Thursday said it created a new company to advise clients on sponsorship.

The new company, M & C Saatchi Sponsorship, was formed in response to growing interest in sponsorship from clients. The new company will have the strategic and creative resources to advise clients on sponsorship and related communication opportunities on a more formal basis than previously, the ad agency said.
Sponsorship, including sponsoring sporting events and television programmes, has become increasingly important to companies.

The new company's first client is Gallaher, an existing M & C Saatchi client. M & C Saatchi will advise, manage and exploit the sponsorship by Gallaher's Benson & Hedges cigarettes of the Jordan team in Formula One.
Gallaher is a British-based unit of American Brands Inc.
Matthew Patten, formerly client services director of Orbit International, was named chief executive of M & C Saatchi Sponsorship.
